summary: A documentation site from Markdown in a repo: Starlight for the site, Pagefind for search, versions and redirects from your old URLs, an edit-in-browser path that opens a pull request with a preview deploy, and a feedback widget. The visual editor and AI assistant stay with GitBook; the docs come home.

stack.choice: A static host with preview deploys
stack.why: the PR flow depends on previews

prerequisites.name: Node.js 22 or newer
prerequisites.why: Everything in this build runs on it: the server, the scripts, the tests.
prerequisites.get: Download the LTS installer from nodejs.org, or install with your package manager (brew install node, or nvm install 22). Restart the terminal afterwards.

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: Your existing docs as Markdown
prerequisites.get: GitBook: enable Git Sync to a repo, or export pages one by one. Note every current URL for the redirect map.

prerequisites.name: A static host with preview deployments
prerequisites.why: Phase 4's edit flow shows a preview per pull request.
prerequisites.get: Cloudflare Pages or Netlify connected to the repository.

prerequisites.name: A domain or subdomain
prerequisites.get: Register at Cloudflare Registrar, Porkbun or Namecheap, or use a subdomain of one you already own. You add one DNS record in the deploy phase.
prerequisites.cost: roughly $10 a year, or free on an existing domain

prerequisites.name: Where feedback goes
prerequisites.why: Phase 5 adds a widget; it needs a destination.
prerequisites.get: A tiny endpoint (see the Formspree entry on this site) or a hosted form.

phases.title: The site
phases.goal: Starlight with your sidebar and three real pages; broken links fail the build.

steps.do: Create the Starlight project and migrate three pages
Enable link checking so a broken internal link fails the build

check: A deliberately broken link fails the build naming the page

phases.title: Search and structure
phases.goal: Pagefind, TOC, tabs, callouts, an OpenAPI page if you have one.

steps.do: Confirm Pagefind indexes code blocks; add tabs and asides
Add an OpenAPI page from your spec if applicable

check: Search finds a term inside a code block
The API page renders from the spec

phases.title: Versions and redirects
phases.goal: Version switcher and every old URL resolving.

steps.do: A redirects file mapping every old GitBook URL

check: Every old URL from your sitemap resolves to a page or an explicit redirect

phases.title: Editing for non-engineers
phases.goal: Edit in the browser, get a PR and a preview link.

steps.do: Edit-this-page links opening the file in the repo host's web editor

check: Someone with no local setup edits a page in the browser and a preview link appears on the PR

phases.title: Deploy and measure
phases.goal: Live on your domain with a feedback widget and a pageview count.

steps.do: Custom domain and a privacy-respecting pageview count
A feedback widget posting to FEEDBACK_ENDPOINT; README with the non-engineer edit steps and the redirect map

check: Docs are live on your domain

phases.title: Operate
phases.goal: Link checks on a schedule and a broken-link budget.

steps.do: A weekly CI job checking external links

check: A dead external link is reported within a week

product.outcome: Docs that live with the code, editable by anyone through a PR, searchable without a service.

architecture.swap: A CMS writing to the repo later

releaseGate: A non-engineer completed an edit via PR

notIncluded: The block editor, the AI assistant, in-browser review workflow.
after: An AI search box over your own docs behind your own key
